summary.text: Owen Lang is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 66, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Eric Matthews (D).
He is a construction professional and U.S. Army National Guard veteran.

paragraphs.text: Owen Lang served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1992 to 2001, according to Ballotpedia, and earned a high school diploma from Bozeman High School.
His career experience includes working in construction.
Lang was the Republican nominee for Montana House of Representatives District 62 in 2024, when Josh Seckinger (D) defeated him, 51.1 percent to 48.9 percent.
He advanced from the Republican primary for District 66 on June 2, 2026.
